component.name: DnfSetup
component.summary: Set up Fedora after installation: firmware, RPM Fusion, codecs, drivers, Flathub

description.p: The usual post-install checklist for Fedora KDE as one window: update the system and firmware, enable RPM Fusion, full multimedia codecs, video acceleration for Intel and AMD, the NVIDIA driver matching your card, Flathub without its filter, and extras like Microsoft fonts or DVD playback.
It shows which steps are already done, asks for your password once and runs the rest with a progress bar. Checked on Fedora 45.
